claims.text: Jade Mountain sits above the 600-acre Anse Chastanet beachfront estate in St. Lucia.

findings.quote: Perched majestically above Anse Chastanet’s 600-acre beachfront estate, Jade Mountain Resort in St. Lucia

claims.text: Jade Mountain was designed by its architect-owner, Nick Troubetzkoy.

findings.quote: Designed by architect-owner Nick Troubetzkoy

claims.text: The sanctuaries have unobstructed views of the Pitons and the Caribbean Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

findings.quote: These architectural marvels provide unobstructed views of the iconic Pitons and the vast Caribbean Sea—designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

claims.text: The infinity pools are surfaced entirely in one-of-a-kind glass tiles designed specifically for Jade Mountain.

findings.quote: They have been surfaced entirely in one-of-a-kind glass tiles, which have been specifically designed for JADE MOUNTAIN.

claims.text: The infinity pools are lit at night by fibre optics that can cycle through colours or hold one shade.

findings.quote: The infinity pools are equipped with fibre optics to illuminate them at night. Guests have the option of allowing the system to cycle through a range of colours or setting it to one particular shade.

claims.text: The bathrooms have an open floor design that makes them part of the sanctuary.

findings.quote: The open floor design allows the bathrooms to become part of the sanctuary experience

claims.text: The Jade Mountain Club, wrapped around a colorful infinity pool, caters exclusively to resident guests and serves Chef Allen Susser's Jade Cuisine.

findings.quote: Wrapped around an infinity pool with a dazzling kaleidoscope of colors, the Jade Mountain Club caters exclusively to resident guests, celebrating James Beard Award winner Chef Allen Susser’s “Jade Cuisine.”

claims.text: The spa menu includes classic body and beauty treatments as well as Ayurvedic and holistic services.

findings.quote: We offer a large and varied menu of both classic body and beauty treatments, as well as Ayurvedic and holistic services.

claims.text: Yoga classes by resident instructors are non-competitive and open to complete beginners and more advanced students.

findings.quote: The classes by our resident Yoga instructors are non-competitive and open to complete beginners as well as to those more advanced.

claims.text: Guests can visit the resort's Emerald Estate, where organic produce including mango, avocado, guava and cocoa is grown.

findings.quote: A visit to the resort’s Emerald Estate, where a variety of organic produce is grown, including mango, avocado, guava, and cocoa, is a delightful exploration.

claims.text: The resort is in the south of the island, within easy reach of the rainforest, Botanical Gardens, Drive-In Volcano and Sulphur Springs.

findings.quote: Being situated in the southern part of the island, major sightseeing attractions such as the rainforest, Botanical Gardens, Drive-In Volcano, and Sulphur Springs are all within easy reach.

claims.text: The team can arrange a guided hike up the Gros Piton.

findings.quote: ask the team to arrange for a guided hike up the Gros Piton

claims.text: Each sanctuary is reached by its own bridge leading to a private infinity pool sanctuary, set among rugged stone columns.

findings.quote: Each sanctuary is accessed via individual bridges leading to private infinity pool sanctuaries, with rugged stone columns that soar into the sky.

claims.text: Each ensuite infinity pool has a unique design in both colour and shape.

findings.quote: the design of each pool is unique both in colour and shape

claims.text: The chromatherapy whirlpool tubs are for one or two people and sit on a pedestal for panoramic views while bathing.

findings.quote: The chromatherapy whirlpool tubs are designed to be enjoyed by one or two persons and they are mounted on a pedestal, allowing the best possible panoramic views whilst bathing.

claims.text: Spa treatments are available in the privacy of the guest's infinity pool sanctuary or at the Kai en Ciel spa.

findings.quote: Jade Mountain guests can choose from a carefully selected menu of spa treatments available in the privacy of their infinity pool sanctuary or in Jade Mountain’s boutique St. Lucia spa, Kai en Ciel.

claims.text: At the resort's Chocolate Lab, chocolate is produced from organically grown cocoa on the property.

findings.quote: Chocoholics will be thrilled with a visit to the resort’s Chocolate Lab, where chocolate is produced from organically grown cocoa right on the property.

claims.text: Jade Mountain sits above the beachfront estate; the Anse Chastanet and Anse Mamin beaches are a short walk away.

findings.quote: Perched majestically above Anse Chastanet’s 600-acre beachfront estate
Anse Chastanet and Anse Mamin beaches, accessible on foot (a short walk)

claims.text: Kai en Ciel, the spa at Jade Mountain, has two air-conditioned rooms plus hair, manicure and pedicure stations.

findings.quote: Kai en Ciel (Patois/Creole for house in heaven) is part of Jade Mountain, featuring two air-conditioned rooms in addition to hair, manicure and pedicure stations.

claims.text: A 10% service charge is added to all spa treatments.

findings.quote: A 10% service charge is added in all instances.
